populationKinds.historicalCohort: Deal DATE_CREATE falls in the inclusive Tashkent calendar range; canonical project membership is then applied.
populationKinds.periodOutcome: Stored wonAt falls in the inclusive Tashkent calendar range, regardless of DATE_CREATE.

readOnlyAnalyticsQuery: SELECT deal_id, payload, json_valid(payload) AS payload_valid FROM analytics_records ORDER BY deal_id

metrics.businessDefinition: One canonical project Deal created in the selected historical cohort.
metrics.authoritativeCrmEvidence: Bitrix Deal ID, original DATE_CREATE, recorded entry into the selected Sales funnel, current project-funnel membership; projectLeadMembership/currentScope in analytics is the synchronized decision.
inclusionRules: DATE_CREATE is inside the inclusive range
legacy rows without membership are included unless lossReasonGroup is ROUTING
metrics.deduplicationRule: COUNT(DISTINCT Bitrix dealId); Contact/Company duplicates remain separate Deals.
metrics.funnelCategoryBehavior: Selected Sales plus its matching brand post-sale funnel are one project; unrelated and call-center funnels are excluded.
expectedInvariants: Lead = SQL + Not Relevant + Saralanmagan
One Deal ID appears once
knownEdgeCases: UNRESOLVED membership remains visible
Historical completeness is bounded by synchronized analytics coverage
A Deal created outside Sales can qualify after recorded Sales entry

metrics.authoritativeCrmEvidence: Stored qualified=true derived from configured SQL/Обработка or downstream stage evidence, or canonical WON evidence.
metrics.dateField: createdAt for cohort membership; qualifiedAt is evidence metadata, not membership
metrics.funnelCategoryBehavior: SQL evidence is from selected Sales stages; matching post-sale/WON proves acceptance.
expectedInvariants: SQL and Not Relevant are disjoint
Sales Lost is a subset of SQL
WON is SQL
knownEdgeCases: Current runtime may qualify a direct Sales closure; qualifiedStageId remains absent as a process diagnostic
Missing legacy qualified values fail certification rather than being inferred

metrics.businessDefinition: Marketing low-quality Lead whose final quality classification is Not Relevant.
metrics.authoritativeCrmEvidence: Configured/current Not Relevant stage produces salesStatus LOW_QUALITY and lossReasonGroup MARKETING.
metrics.funnelCategoryBehavior: Not Relevant remains Marketing low quality even after a prior SQL visit; failure-reason text cannot override the stage verdict.
expectedInvariants: Not Relevant cannot also be SQL
Not Relevant is not Sales Lost
knownEdgeCases: Prior SQL history must not reclassify final Not Relevant
Renamed stages depend on configured stable stage IDs

metrics.businessDefinition: Lead whose quality has been decided: accepted as SQL or rejected as Not Relevant.
metrics.authoritativeCrmEvidence: Canonical qualified flag or MARKETING loss group.
metrics.deduplicationRule: Set union by dealId, never arithmetic addition without the disjointness check.
metrics.funnelCategoryBehavior: Classification follows quality evidence, not display-stage names.
expectedInvariants: Saralangan + Saralanmagan = Lead
When SQL/NR disjoint, Saralangan = SQL + Not Relevant
knownEdgeCases: A SQL/Not Relevant conflict fails certification

metrics.businessDefinition: Canonical Lead with no recorded quality verdict yet.
metrics.authoritativeCrmEvidence: Absence of both qualified=true and MARKETING loss group.
metrics.funnelCategoryBehavior: Pre-SQL stages such as distribution/no answer are unclassified, not low quality.
expectedInvariants: Lead = SQL + Not Relevant + Saralanmagan
knownEdgeCases: Young cohorts can have high Saralanmagan
Direct-close treatment follows the stored qualified flag and is not re-derived by the validator

metrics.businessDefinition: Quality-accepted Lead closed and not realized by Sales.
metrics.authoritativeCrmEvidence: Stored lossReasonGroup SALES plus qualified=true, derived from configured closed-lost outcome and qualification evidence.
metrics.funnelCategoryBehavior: Closed-and-not-realized is separate from Not Relevant; routing reasons are separate.
expectedInvariants: Sales Lost <= SQL
Every Sales Lost Deal ID is in SQL
knownEdgeCases: Missing failure reason is a data-quality issue
Direct-close process signals do not change the stored KPI classification

metrics.businessDefinition: Canonical Leads created in the selected range that eventually became won.
metrics.authoritativeCrmEvidence: Payment-stage history or entry into matching brand post-sale funnel; frozen sale snapshot preserves wonAt and seller.
metrics.dateField: createdAt controls cohort membership; wonAt may be outside the range
exclusionRules: WON Deals created outside the range
metrics.deduplicationRule: Payment and post-sale evidence for the same dealId count once.
metrics.funnelCategoryBehavior: Sales + matching post-sale are one project; cross-brand post-sale does not win the Deal.
expectedInvariants: Every Cohort Sale is SQL
Cohort Sales and Period Sales use separate selectors
knownEdgeCases: A Deal can belong to both Cohort and Period Sales
Frozen wonAt overrides later CRM movement
metrics.exactValidator: eligible created cohort filtered by salesStatus === 'WON'

metrics.businessDefinition: Won Deals whose frozen wonAt falls in the selected range, regardless of creation date.
metrics.authoritativeCrmEvidence: Frozen deal_sales_snapshots.won_at backed by payment history or matching post-sale entry.
metrics.deduplicationRule: One dealId once; payment plus post-sale never double-counts.
metrics.funnelCategoryBehavior: May include an older cohort Deal sold now; remains scoped to synchronized project analytics.
expectedInvariants: Period Sales uses wonAt and Cohort Sales uses createdAt
Every Period Sale is SQL
knownEdgeCases: Deal 40099 is the certified cross-check
Same Deal may overlap Cohort Sales without being a duplicate

metrics.businessDefinition: SUM(OPPORTUNITY) for Period Sales; Cohort Revenue is separately SUM(OPPORTUNITY) for Cohort Sales.
metrics.authoritativeCrmEvidence: Bitrix Deal OPPORTUNITY and CURRENCY_ID stored on each won analytics record.
metrics.dateField: wonAt for Period Revenue; createdAt for Cohort Revenue
exclusionRules: Mixed/missing currency aggregate is blocked, not converted
metrics.deduplicationRule: Sum one OPPORTUNITY per unique dealId.
metrics.funnelCategoryBehavior: Uses matching project sale evidence; no currency conversion or Finance data.
expectedInvariants: Revenue = SUM(OPPORTUNITY)
No mixed currency aggregation
knownEdgeCases: Zero-value sale is valid
Invalid OPPORTUNITY or mixed currency prevents certification

metrics.businessDefinition: Seller responsible for a completed sale, grouped with its preserved evidence source.
metrics.authoritativeCrmEvidence: salesManagerId/name/attribution from stable sale snapshot and approved runtime evidence chain.
metrics.dateField: wonAt (manager report population is Period Sales)
inclusionRules: All Period Sales, including unknown/unreviewed rows
exclusionRules: Current assignee is not substituted for a missing completed-sale seller
metrics.deduplicationRule: COUNT(DISTINCT dealId) grouped by seller plus attribution source.
metrics.funnelCategoryBehavior: Later post-sale/customer-care ownership cannot replace a frozen seller.
expectedInvariants: Seller-only changes preserve Lead, SQL, NR, Sales, Revenue and wonAt
Manager rows reconcile to Period Sales
knownEdgeCases: FIRST_CALL and CURRENT_RESPONSIBLE are visible but uncertified
UNKNOWN remains explicit
HUMAN_REVIEW is a disposition, not an attribution source
Unrecognized provenance requires review

metrics.businessDefinition: Bitrix standard SOURCE_ID and its CRM dictionary label, audited without silently merging raw values.
metrics.authoritativeCrmEvidence: Deal SOURCE_ID plus crm.status.list ENTITY_ID=SOURCE dictionary.
inclusionRules: All eligible cohort Leads grouped by exact raw sourceId plus raw label
metrics.deduplicationRule: One dealId per exact raw-source group.
metrics.funnelCategoryBehavior: Source is independent of funnel stage; standard SOURCE_ID only, no UTM/custom-field fallback.
expectedInvariants: Source deal counts reconcile to Lead
Raw groups remain separate even when spelling keys match
knownEdgeCases: Blank SOURCE_ID is MISSING
Nonblank unresolved SOURCE_ID is UNKNOWN
Only exact CRM-forma/Meta/Google/organic-other audit labels are tagged
Instagram/Facebook and other ambiguous labels stay UNMAPPED
